summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: xerohub-discord-voice-v2 exposes a startVoiceJoiner() API that, on every invocation, POSTs the caller-supplied Discord user token (a full-account bearer credential) together with the associated username, server ID, and channel ID to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/... via axios. The destination is embedded in Xerohub_Voice.js as DEVELOPER_BACKEND_WEBHOOK and is only overridable via the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable; it cannot be disabled, so normal use of the module silently transmits the caller's Discord credentials to an author-controlled endpoint. The token is first validated against discord.com/users/@me and then relayed with a SHA256 fingerprint alongside the raw value.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
